en: Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog in the remaining dialogs and pickers, such as `/memory`, `/hooks`, `/mcp` (including a server's sign-in screen), `/export`, `/copy`, `/theme`, and `/teleport`'s uncommitted-changes and login prompts (where Esc also quit)
zh: 修复在其余对话框和选择器中连按两次 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 会退出 Claude Code 而非关闭对话框的问题，涉及 `/memory`、`/hooks`、`/mcp`（包括服务器的登录界面）、`/export`、`/copy`、`/theme`，以及 `/teleport` 的未提交变更和登录提示（这些位置按 Esc 也会退出）
